**Finding: deviation (INDEMN — Indemnification by Vendor)**

Section 12 contains mutual indemnities, but TrueLink's side (12(b)) is limited to its own breach of the Agreement or non-performance. There is no third-party IP infringement indemnity anywhere in the document, and no TrueLink non-infringement warranty for a breach-based indemnity to attach to — Section 2 only protects TrueLink's IP and imposes trademark-search duties on us, and Section 12's disclaimer strips implied warranties. A vendor indemnity that excludes IP infringement fails even the playbook's fallback position, and the imbalance is sharpened by the very broad Client indemnity in 12(a).

Redline (validated, `ok:true`): expands 12(b) to cover (i) TrueLink breach/non-performance, (ii) third-party IP infringement or misappropriation claims relating to the Interface, Hosting/Support Services and deliverables, (iii) TrueLink's breach of law, (iv) unauthorized access to or disclosure of Client Content/data caused by TrueLink, and (v) TrueLink's gross negligence or willful misconduct, plus standard notice/control/cooperation mechanics. The comment offers the fallback (IP-only indemnity with customary modification/combination/specification exclusions) as a landing zone.
